rules.subject: protean
rules.source_section: Effect / In battle / Pokémon Champions; Champions flavor text
claims: First move after entering changes the holder to the move type
Effect can occur only once until next entry
rules.test_scope: first move, second move, switch-in reset

rules.subject: protean
claims: Greninja with Protean that changed type reverts to Water/Dark upon Mega Evolution
Mega Greninja gets a new Protean use

rules.subject: knockoff
rules.source_section: Description / Champs; Effect / Generation IX / Pokémon Champions
claims: Power increased by 50 percent when target holds a removable item
Item still removed even if attacker faints from target ability or Rocky Helmet
rules.test_scope: known removable item; no held item; misses; attacker faints from contact
not_verified: uncertain removability, Sticky Hold, substitute, ability interaction

rules.subject: whiteherb
claims: Held item disappears after one use
rules.test_scope: post-stat-drop evaluation with negative and positive stages
not_verified: precise activation point during multi-hit/Knock Off

rules.subject: choicescarf
claims: After using a move cannot use another move until switching out
rules.test_scope: executed move creates lock; same move can be repeated; different move is rejected; switching clears lock
not_verified: choice lock when selected move never executes
